posts.title: Day one of legal amphetamine usage
posts.description: I’ve been handed a prescription for Elvanse, which is lisdexamfetamine. Fancy. The prescriber has me on a fairly rapid escalation schedule for it which I initially thought might be a bit dramatic but I’m onto hour 4ish of it and, so far, everything seems fine? I’ve heard all sorts of horror stories about it, even at this dose, and lots of people saying that the initial doses before you become acclimatised are especially exciting. I have to admit that, at this stage, I’m not seeing a great deal of that. What I can say is that things feel a little bit sharper and my mind is much quieter. Not sure it’s done a great deal for task activation as I need to reset the coffee pot and haven’t managed to get off the sofa to do that, but at least I’m not on a ladder cleaning the gutters! What this does suggest is that the diagnosis is correct; if I were neurotypical I would, in the vernacular, be buzzing my tits off. The worst side effect of all I’ve had to switch to decaf. At least Pact do a prope

posts.title: It’s all going FIDO
posts.description: Per recent comments about ADHD , I got hit by the “ oooh I should do this” bat and have gone out and bought a pair of YubiKeys. I don’t consider myself an especially high risk user or a particularly valuable target for state actors (my crypto wealth hovering around the £10 mark is not going to be attracting the big players) but I am apparently now phishing resistant. Which is nice. Stray entries Can’t work out how the one below this has come to pass. I may have to ask for some tech support! Fixed! Stray bbedit project file that finally became active, and a ten minute response from blot.im’s support. Can’t get better than that!

posts.title: It’s like losing a limb…
posts.description: The dust-in-the-screen issue with the macbook has finally got too much and so I have, with great reluctance, finally taken it in for some Applecare action. For the price of the excess I’m also getting the dent in the bottom beaten out replaced. It’ll only take a few days and I’m sure I’ll manage without it, but it’s a wrench! In the meantime, Linux Mint on a refurbed Thinkpad T490 . S’alright, actually. Missing lots of software bits I take for granted, Ubuntu base rather than Debian, but otherwise fine, especially as it only cost GBP200 . The only gripe is that I didn’t check that it was GB keyboard…
